_doc: ability.actions.<name>(props) → our Act. kind: card = acts on the ability's selection (default context.source → s:"self"; inside a `target` block → s:"target"); player = acts on a player (default: `default`; explicit `target: context.player[.opponent]` flips `opp` when the DSL k has `oppField`); token = no selection (makeToken); flow = sequential/joint, flattened. defaults = fields written when the prop is absent (keyteki setDefaultProperties). props: every keyteki prop the entry understands — {field} copies a literal, {ifTrue}/{ifFalse} merge fields on a boolean literal (null deletes a field). Anything not listed (and not cosmetic) is Unsupported("prop:<name>"): fail closed. pending/unsupported entries only document the reason; the code is always action:<name>. Lote 15c (action-zones): archive/removeStun/removeAmber espelham atos que o motor ja tem (archive/unstun/moveAmber->supply). placeAmber (supply -> criatura) NAO tem ato (o capture debita um pool) = engineGap do relatorio; putIntoArchives/moveCard/discard de zona seguem o move do DSL em entradas futuras. Lote 15d (lasting-effects): kind lasting = ability.actions.<duracao>(props) → {k:"lasting", e:{target, …, duration}}. Durações: untilPlayerTurnEnd→turn, duringOpponentNextTurn/untilPlayerNextTurnStart→next, untilPlayerNextTurnEnd→nextTurn (motor v16). Efeitos suportados dentro: os de tables/effects.json (modifyPower/modifyArmor/addKeyword/modifyKeyCost/changeHouse); takeControl/canUse/canPlayNonHouse/gainAbility/changeType/playerCannot/cardCannot como efeito ficam de fora (engineGap).

discardAtRandom.notes: location other than hand is not declared → unsupported

dealDamage.notes: splash/ignoreArmor/fightEvent not declared; amountForCard (dynamic) is M2

archive.notas: Lote 15c: ArchiveAction em carta em jogo -> archive do DSL.

putIntoArchives.notas: Lote 15f: PutIntoArchivesAction = archive (o ato do DSL, play→archives).

cardLastingEffect.notas: Lote 15d: lasting por carta (29 usos); match → e.target. when/gameAction (lasting com gatilho) e until: untilLeavesPlay ficam de fora.

lastingEffect.notas: Lote 15d: duração default untilPlayerTurnEnd; o prop duration/until pode sobrescrever (só as chaves do mapa DURATIONS).

untilPlayerTurnEnd.notas: Lote 15d: "For the remainder of the turn" (74 usos).

duringOpponentNextTurn.notas: Lote 15d: "during their next turn" (31 usos) — janela stamp+2.

untilPlayerNextTurnStart.notas: Lote 15d: "until the start of your next turn" (6 usos).

untilPlayerNextTurnEnd.notas: Lote 15d: "until the end of your next turn" (1 uso) — janela stamp+3.

removeAmber.notas: Lote 15c: RemoveTokenAction(amber) = moveAmber para o supply comum.
